narrative.summary: A fully-traced chain: Governor → a real 4-day Timelock → a 4-of-8 DAO Safe, with a separate 2-of-3 securityCouncil able to cancel. Despite Euler’s own “DAO” naming, this is Safe-and-Timelock-gated, not a token-vote DAO.
narrative.tag: best-governed target on this chain, cross-exposure: 80 (pushed on-chain 2026-09-20)
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: the DAO Safe’s 8 signers are identical, as an exact set, to the signers of Euler’s DAO Safe on Monad (a different Safe address per chain), so crossExposureScore is folded to a flat 80 against a dated 2026-09-19 snapshot of Monad’s DAO signers; admin, multisig and timelock are unchanged. 156 vaults deployed through this factory; at least one confirmed live to be retroactively upgradeable by this exact authority chain. A real, disclosed concentration: securityCouncil’s third signer is itself the separate "labs" Safe, and all 6 of labs’ own signers are a subset of the DAO Safe’s 8, so a smaller group of people sits behind more than one nominally-separate committee here. Not covered by the score: PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE on the Governor is held by the Labs Safe and two bare EOAs, and either EOA alone can pause the factory (confirmed by eth_call simulation), an instant availability freeze that the timelock does not gate.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)
